# Before you update the telco core CNF cluster {#update-before-the-update}

Before you start the cluster update, you must pause worker nodes, back up the etcd database, and do a final cluster health check before proceeding.

**Additional resources**

- [Backing up etcd](/openshift-docs-markdown/backup_and_restore/control_plane_backup_and_restore/backing-up-etcd#backup-etcd)
